_template_notes.purpose: Predictive regression impact map — Engine #6 upgrade. Phase 6 output. Mode: predictive (GitNexus impact) hoặc diff-aware (git diff fallback). Skip nếu profile=quick HOẶC --since không set. Tham chiếu 04-file-contract.md §4.4.
populate: changed_files[]: list relative paths đã đổi từ since_ref đến HEAD
predicted_impact.direct_callers[]: file gọi trực tiếp changed file — {file, confidence ∈ [0,1]}
predicted_impact.transitive_callers[]: file gọi gián tiếp (>1 hop) — {file, confidence, hops}
predicted_impact.affected_modules[]: modules có ≥1 file bị impact — {module, confidence, reason (FK chain, event chain, ...)}
predicted_impact.affected_workflows[]: business workflows bị impact — {workflow, confidence, broken_step?}
predicted_impact.test_plan[]: tests cần chạy lại — {test_id, priority=HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW, reason}
confidence_threshold: 0.7 default — filter impact dưới threshold
